BUSINESS IT SERVICES

IT rollouts and office migrations.

IT rollouts and migrations coordinate repeatable technical changes across users, devices or sites. HeyDock scopes device refreshes, software deployments, office IT moves and related migration work with agreed testing and handover. A successful rollout begins with a dependable inventory and a pilot.

Discuss requirementsExplore services

SERVICE EXPLAINED

What does this service involve?

Large changes become manageable when the process is repeatable. Before scheduling engineers, establish which devices are included, which configuration is approved and how exceptions will be handled. A small pilot can expose access, application or timing issues before they affect the wider rollout.

The engagement starts by identifying the business outcome, existing responsibilities and the changes you authorise. HeyDock then confirms suitable delivery capacity, the working window and the evidence needed to complete the task. Related licences, hardware, subscriptions and specialist services are included only where the proposal says so.

PRACTICAL SCOPE

What can be included?

The final statement of work identifies the tasks that apply to your environment.

Preparation and inventory

Record assets, users, locations, applications and dependencies. Confirm delivery dates, available stock, software rights and the information needed to configure each device.

Pilot and deployment waves

Test the process with representative users, then organise waves around business availability. Record exceptions and completion status so incomplete tasks do not disappear into a simple device count.

Migration and handover

Agree backup checkpoints, data validation, user communication and support after cutover. Update asset records and retain evidence that the user or site meets acceptance criteria.

EXAMPLE REQUIREMENT

How a project might work.

A multi-site laptop refresh can use a common build, site-specific booking windows and an exception queue. The final report distinguishes deployed devices from devices awaiting access, parts or user acceptance.

PLANNING AND COST

What affects the scope and price?

Cost depends on the number of users, devices or sites; technical complexity; access requirements; delivery hours; travel; and the work needed before and after implementation. Provide relevant system versions and existing supplier responsibilities so the quotation can distinguish labour from licences, equipment and recurring charges.

For a well-defined task, a visit or project quotation may be appropriate. Where important dependencies are unknown, a paid assessment can produce a better implementation scope. Any response, attendance or recovery target must be explicitly agreed; requesting a service does not create an immediate support commitment.

COMMON QUESTIONS

IT rollouts and office migrations FAQs

Can you work with our existing deployment process?+

Yes. The work can follow your approved build, tooling and reporting requirements after review.

Is data migration automatically included?+

No. Data volumes, sources, permissions, validation and recovery must be explicitly scoped.

What information should we include in an enquiry?+

Describe the objective, location, affected systems, preferred timing and existing support arrangements. Do not send passwords or sensitive business records in the enquiry form.
